body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> JVC Mobile Entertainment introduced five new Arsenal CD and multimedia receivers to fulfill the growing demand for in-vehicle convenience and expandability at CES. As with all Arsenal Series receivers, the 2010 CD and multimedia models carry a 2-year warranty, Steering Wheel Remote Control capability, and High Voltage 5V pre-outs.

The new KD-A815 in-dash CD Receiver features front auxiliary input, dual USB ports, 2-way iPod/iPhone control, Bluetooth wireless technology via included USB Bluetooth adapter, and External mode for iPod/iPhone which allows USB audio playback from iPhone/iPod Touch applications. It also features MP3/WMA playback capability, MOS-FET 50 watts x 4, front/rear and sub pre-outs, separated variable-color illumination display, and a wireless remote. The receiver is available for shipping in March and has a MSRP of $239.95.

JVC will continue its strong HD Radio presence with a new KD-AHD69 in-dash CD Receiver; including a built-in HD Radio tuner with iTunes Tagging capability. This CD receiver is also Satellite ready, iPod ready, with front USB port for 2-way iPod/iPhone control, MP3/WMA compatible, Bluetooth ready, and features the separated variable-color illumination display. It features front auxiliary input, 7-band iEQ, MOS-FET 50W x 4, includes wireless remote and is steering wheel remote control ready. The receiver is available in January with an MSRP of $189.95.

The new Arsenal Series KD-A615 CD Receiver features a direct USB 2.0 connection for the iPod/iPhone, providing 2-way iPod/iPhone control, charging, and high-speed song selection. The unit is also equipped for readiness with Bluetooth, HD and Satellite Radio. The receiver is MP3/WMA compatible and has a front auxiliary input, loudness control, separated variable-color illumination display, HS-IVi tuner, includes wireless remote and is steering wheel remote control ready. The KD-A615 also features MOS-FET 50W x 4 and a 3-band iEQ. The receiver is available in January with an MSRP of $149.95.

The new KD-A315 in-dash CD Receiver features upgrade options for Bluetooth via JVC's KS-BTA200 adapter as well as a front auxiliary input, and readiness for both HD and Satellite radio. The KD-A315 also features a 3-Band Parametric iEQ, HS-IVi tuner, J-Bus terminal, steering wheel remote ready, MOS-FET 50W x 4, wireless remote control, and the all new separated variable-color illumination display, capable of over 30,000 x 30,000 customizable color combinations to match your car's interior lighting. The receiver is currently available with an MSRP of $109.95.

The Arsenal KW-ADV793 DVD/CD/USB multimedia receiver features a 7-inch motorized widescreen touch panel display, proximity sensor and detachable face. The unit includes a USB 2.0 port for 2-way iPod/iPhone control and is HD, Bluetooth, and SAT ready. The KW-AVX830 is WAV/MP3/WMA compatible, and features a 7-band IEQ, MOS-FET 50 watts x 4, Three sets of 5V pre-outs, subwoofer control, wireless remote, and 2-year warranty. The receiver is $549.95 and will be available for shipping in March.
